title: Bind Snapshot
statement: Implement `solve(first, second)`. A from-import captured `first`. The module later rebinds the name to `second`. Return `{"local": first, "module": second}`. The local name does not follow the rebind.
hints: Do not return second for both.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: from module import name binds the current object into the local namespace.

editorial: from module import name binds the current object into the local namespace. A later assignment in the module changes the module attribute and not the local name. That is why a patch must target the name in the module that uses it, and why a reloaded function does not update old from-imports.
reference_solution:
def solve(first, second):
    return {"local": first, "module": second}
